title: A Physics Professor Bet Me $10,000 I'm Wrong
summary: Veritasium recounts a $10,000 bet with a UCLA physics professor over whether a vehicle can travel downwind faster than the wind. He presents the professor's reasoning and demonstrations, including one without aerodynamics.
why: Linked as clear demonstrations that make the counterintuitive faster-than-wind result click.

quote.text: The small demonstration that made it click for me is from that video
